competitive_landscape: San Pedro Belize Express + Ocean Ferry dominate the corridor; Tropic Air + Maya Island Air dominate the air gateway. Local diesel dive-boats handle Hol Chan / Shark-Ray Alley / Blue Hole staging. No electric / foiling tier exists. The premium resort-transfer and quiet-mode tender tiers are both wide open.

Pioneer II quiet-mode foiling tender — fully zero-wake compatible inside the UNESCO reserve.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the airport-to-resort premium transfer tier (~35 nm), Hol Chan / Shark-Ray Alley tender (~4 nm), and the resort-jetty local network — all inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope on flat protected reef water.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: N35 Shuttle is the corridor-shuttle platform — San Pedro↔Caye Caulker (~15 nm) and the longer reef-corridor legs. Hybrid Quanta-LR is the longer-horizon Belize↔Quintana Roo / Yucatán trunk option.

precedents.why_it_matters: San Pedro is the resort-arrivals endpoint of the hero corridor — pairs natively with the Belize City build.

regulatory_note: Belize Port Authority + Belize Tourism Board regulate operators. Hol Chan Marine Reserve and Bacalar Chico National Park (both off Ambergris Caye) are strict conservation regimes — citable quiet-mode anchors. UNESCO Belize Barrier Reef Reserve System.
seasonality: Year-round operability; dry season (December–April) is peak resort tourism, wet season (June–November) brings occasional tropical-storm windows but the corridor stays generally workable inside the reef.

summary: Ambergris Caye (San Pedro) is Belize's largest island and top tourist destination — the resort and hospitality anchor of the reef corridor and the gateway to dive sites (Hol Chan, Shark-Ray Alley, Blue Hole staging). Strong as the resort-arrivals endpoint of the hero corridor and a hospitality-brand spoke in its own right. Pairs with the Belize City–Cayes corridor build; the local Ambergris archetype is premium-resort transfer plus Hol Chan tender.
tagline: Belize's resort + dive anchor — San Pedro is the hospitality endpoint of the Cayes corridor and a hub for Hol Chan + Blue Hole staging.
